name: Papepo Local WebP Converter
author: PAPEPO

sections.description:
Papepo Local WebP Converter is built for website owners who demand peak performance and maximum cost-efficiency. Unlike most cloud-based image optimizers on the market that charge per image or require expensive monthly subscriptions, our tool fully utilizes your website’s local server resources to process images.

This means:

  • Zero Cost: Never pay monthly fees or buy optimization credits again.
  • Unlimited Quotas: Whether you upload 100 or 100,000 images, they are all processed completely free of charge.
  • 100% Privacy: Your images never leave your server. No data is sent to third-party APIs, ensuring total GDPR compliance.

Key Features

  • Auto WebP Conversion: Automatically converts incoming JPG and PNG uploads into Google’s recommended next-gen WebP format.
  • On-the-Fly Optimization: Images are compressed and converted instantly during the upload process without disrupting your workflow.
  • Custom Quality Control: You have full control over the compression quality (80% recommended) to perfectly balance visual fidelity and file size.
  • Server Environment Check: Built-in tool to automatically verify if your server supports GD or Imagick libraries for local WebP processing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the papepo-local-webp-converter folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Papepo Local WebP in the left admin menu to configure your compression quality.
  4. Any new images uploaded to your Media Library will now be automatically optimized!
sections.faq:
Is it really 100% free?

Yes! Because we use your server’s own processing power (PHP GD/Imagick) to compress the images, there are no cloud computing costs involved. We have made this tool completely free and unlimited for all users.

Do I need an API Key or account?

No. Once installed, it works immediately out of the box. No registration or third-party accounts are required.

Will this degrade my image quality?

The WebP format is designed to significantly reduce file size while maintaining a visual quality that is nearly indistinguishable from the original to the human eye. You can also adjust the compression quality percentage in the settings if you need higher fidelity.
